subject: SIG / RFI: Evidence intake & kickoff call for Cedarline Bank
messages:
From: Emily Chen <echen@cedarline.bank>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cedarline.bank>
Date: 2028-10-05T15:12:00Z
Subject: Cedarline RFI: initial artifact request and kickoff

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Cedarline's security review team has a few follow-up asks as we move into the formal RFI stage. We want to map your controls to our SIG questionnaire and pull a small evidence bundle ahead of a technical kick-off. High-level asks: 

- Control mapping to SIG: please map Redwood controls to SIG categories (Access mgmt, System and Communications, Change mgmt, Monitoring, Data protection).
- Example evidence for SOC 2/ISO: KMS key rotation proof, sample audit logs (redacted), architecture diagram showing segmentation, and the most recent SOC 2 in-scope test results or bridge letter.
- Timeline: we’d like a short intake call and to get an evidence manifest within 5 business days if possible.

Attached is the RFI questionnaire (Cedarline_RFI_v1.pdf) with our required fields flagged. Can we schedule a 30-minute intake/kickoff on either 10/06 or 10/07, US Eastern?

Also—please include a primary technical contact for the call and someone who can own the evidence drops.

Appreciate it,

Emily Chen
Security Manager, Cedarline Bank
[Attachment: Cedarline_RFI_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <echen@cedarline.bank>
Cc: Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cedarline.bank>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-05T17:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedarline RFI: initial artifact request and kickoff

Emily — thanks for the clear asks and the questionnaire. We can definitely take this on. Proposed plan: 

1) Short intake call (30m) to review the questionnaire scope and confirm required artifacts. Proposed slots (US ET): 10/06 10:00–10:30, 10/06 15:00–15:30, or 10/07 09:00–09:30. Please pick one.

2) Deliverables before the call (we'll upload a manifest to a secure drive): 
   - initial control mapping (SIG -> Redwood controls) — see attached sig_control_map_v1.xlsx stub
   - evidence manifest listing sample artifacts we can deliver in the first wave (evidence_manifest.csv)

3) Notes on sensitive artifacts: we will provide redacted logs and a signed attestation for KMS operations where full raw logs contain customer data. For keys/crypto provenance we can provide key rotation records and HSM/KMS configuration snapshots.

I've looped in Karthik (security ops) and Jasmine (assurance lead) who will support artifact curation and the call. I'll upload a v2 of the control map after the intake with per-control owner and expected delivery dates.

Attachments: sig_control_map_v1.xlsx, evidence_manifest.csv

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sig_control_map_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: evidence_manifest.csv (text/csv)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Emily Chen <echen@cedarline.bank>, Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cedarline.bank>
Date: 2028-10-06T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedarline RFI: initial artifact request and kickoff

Kim / team — quick internal note before the intake call. Two items to flag so we can set expectations with Cedarline: 

- Telemetry/log samples: we'll provide a 48–72 hour slice of redacted access logs showing privileged actions and session metadata. We will redact PII and customer identifiers; we will sign an attestation confirming the redaction process.
- KMS evidence: we can provide key rotation entries (timestamps and rotation policy) and a signed HSM configuration snapshot. For any escrow/third-party hardware statements we may need a short lead time to coordinate legal.

I suggest we propose the 10/07 09:00–09:30 ET slot (gives us one business day to prep the sample manifest). Also: Jasmine — please pre-populate the control map v2 with the recommended artifact column so we can point Cedarline to what's immediate vs. requires legal.

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Chen <echen@cedarline.bank>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cedarline.bank>
Date: 2028-10-06T12:21:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedarline RFI: initial artifact request and kickoff

Kim, Karthik — 10/07 09:00–09:30 ET works for us. Gabe and I will join. A couple of quick clarifications before the call: 

- NDA/Docs access: Cedarline legal needs an executed review NDA for certain artifacts. Can you share a DocuSign link or confirm Redwood has a standard mutual NDA?
- Evidence tokenization: for anything you mark as 'requires legal' we will accept a signed attestation and a sample rather than full raw artifacts.

I'll send a calendar invite for 10/07 09:00 ET and include a link to our RFI tracker.

Thanks,
Emily
Security Manager, Cedarline Bank
[Link: https://docusign.net/cedarline/nda-req-2028]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <echen@cedarline.bank>
Cc: Gabe Ortiz <gabe.ortiz@cedarline.bank>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-07T11:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Cedarline RFI: initial artifact request and kickoff

Emily/Gabe — confirmed for 10/07 09:00 ET. Calendar invite accepted. Quick prep notes and links (we'll upload to the secure folder this afternoon): 

Action items before call (owner / ETA):
- Kimberly: upload sig_control_map_v2.xlsx with per-control owner + suggested artifact (ETA: 10/07 16:00 ET) [Attachment planned]
- Jasmine: compile redacted telemetry slice and redact log procedure document (ETA: 10/07 16:00 ET)
- Karthik: package KMS rotation summary and HSM snapshot, plus wording for attestation (ETA: 10/08 12:00 ET) — flagged as might need legal sign-off

Doc access / NDA: Redwood uses a standard mutual NDA; I will send via DocuSign this morning. Link to our secure evidence folder (will restrict access to Cedarline participants once NDA is executed): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEfGkR-cedarline-evidence

Attachments we will aim to include in the first upload: sig_control_map_v2.xlsx, redacted_access_logs_sample.txt, evidence_manifest_v1.csv. If anything requires a separate transfer (e.g., HSM vendor attestation) we will note that in the manifest.

See you on the call — I'll bring the control map and Jasmine will run through the log redaction approach.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[Planned attachments: sig_control_map_v2.xlsx, redacted_access_logs_sample.txt, evidence_manifest_v1.csv]
